title.narrative: Fostering Green Transition in Petén TEI
Fostering Green Transition in Petén TEI

description.narrative:
Overall Objective
To link socioeconomic development in the Department of Petén with protection of the environment and sustainable use of natural resources
Specific Objectives (results) are:
1. Improve policy framework and financing for inclusive green economic development in Petén
2. Increase sustainable production and productivity of agriculture, livestock, forestry and tourism
3. Improve waste and waste water management services in the municipalities of Petén-Itzá basin

Bidraget representerar Sveriges stöd till Team Europe-initiativet i Guatemala – ”Fostering Green Transition in Petén.” Det övergripande målet är att koppla samman Peténs socioekonomiska utveckling med miljöskydd och ett hållbart nyttjande av naturresurser, med ett genusperspektiv och kulturell relevans. Projektet är i linje med tre centrala pelare inom TEI: institutionell förstärkning; utveckling av gröna och inkluderande ekonomier; samt hållbarhet i produktiva och miljömässiga system.

The contribution represents Sweden’s support to the Team Europe Initiative in Guatemala – “Fostering Green Transition in Petén.” The overall objective is to link the socio-economic development of Petén with environmental protection and the sustainable use of natural resources, applying a gender-sensitive and culturally relevant approach. The Project is aligned with three key pillars of the TEI: institutional strengthening; the development of green and inclusive economies; and the sustainability of productive and environmental systems.

sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative:
Results obtained up to date
During 2025, the Sustainable Maya Landscapes Project (PMS) advanced in consolidating its territorial intervention model, strengthening the integration between biodiversity conservation and activities that promote inclusive economic development in the department of Petén, within the framework of the Team Europe Initiative Fostering the Green Transition in Petén.
Main results:
1. The project contributed to the conservation of 625,270 hectares of the Maya Biosphere Reserve (MBR) and to an estimated reduction of 675,047 tCO eq in avoided emissions. These results were achieved through interventions aimed at halting degradation and deforestation, preventing and controlling wildfires, promoting forest management economic activities, as well as restoring the forest landscape through the establishment of silvopastoral and agroforestry systems and the promotion of regenerative agriculture practices.
2. The project developed strategic tools such as waste management and characterization plans, which will serve as a basis for improving the implementation of solid waste management actions in six municipalities within the Lake Petén Itzá basin.
3. The project also supported the National Council of Protected Areas in advancing its automation system, obtaining approval from the Presidential Commission for Open and Electronic Government. This effort contributes to the digitalization of public services, enabling community forest organizations to become smart forest communities capable of completing administrative procedures directly from their own territories.
4. Technical capacities of public officials and stakeholders involved in environmental and forest management were strengthened, through specialized technical trainings on conservation, regenerative agriculture, fire prevention, forest governance, among other topics.
5. During this period, the project advanced in strengthening community tourism enterprises and initiatives, directly benefiting 13 groups through technical assistance in business related topics, as well as basic equipment, prioritizing initiatives led by women.
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
